about: Speed budget for the front page, read by speed.js. recorded is the build on 2026-11-14 after A3's lighter page (hand paint as short relative paths, the photos as grey AVIF; film bytes are fetched as they near the screen); limits are recorded + 10 %, timings at least + 25 ms (paint varies 72-96 ms between runs of the same build). Bytes are as served by the walk's plain server (no compression), after a walk down the whole page. Paint and blocking are the middle of three first-visit loads, before any scroll. Timings come from a headless browser without a graphics card. 2026-11-22 (Tom): image, film and total re-recorded for the sharper project media (films 1280/390 wide, stills 1920); the first screen's paint stayed at 80 ms.
